candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, resetPassword only sets the new password and updates the user. It never revokes the user's existing sessions. Refresh tokens are validated against session rows, so a device that was already signed in keeps its session and can still refresh its login. The password-change path in AuthService.update (around line 469) does call sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude, but resetPassword has no equivalent call.

fix.description: After usersService.update in resetPassword, call this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }) so every existing session is revoked. Refresh then fails for all devices.
